novelty_basis: Closure of T-functions under composition - A. Klimov, A. Shamir, A new class of invertible mappings, CHES 2002; see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T-function and https://www.iacr.org/archive/fse2004/30170001/30170001.pdf.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C18.md Theorem 4, induction along the chains using x = x' and y = y' mod 2^r => x*y = x'*y' mod 2^r); 0 low-bit changes for AFF, XOR, ALP in EXP-C18-01; max bias 0.5 in EXP-C18-02
statement: If x*y is a T-function on Z/2^8, then in every QG hash (any number of forward and reversed e-transformations) bit j of every output byte depends only on bits 0..j of the message bytes; flipping an input bit at position r never changes an output bit at a position < r, and the maximal avalanche bias is 1/2.
title: T-function quasigroups (affine mod 256, XOR, (x + 1) XOR y) cannot mix high input bits into low output bits
